Karthik / team — looping in suggested Order Form wording below. I tried to keep it tight, explicit, and with contingency language so we don't overpromise. Please review and flag edits.

PROPOSED ORDER FORM CLAUSE — DATA TURNOVER & DELETION
1) Definitions: “Deletion Event” = customer-initiated service termination or migration request. “Certification” = signed statement confirming irreversible deletion from active instances, snapshots, and backups as applicable.
2) Production Logs: Redwood will purge production inference logs within thirty (30) calendar days following a Deletion Event. Redwood will provide Certification within twenty-one (21) calendar days following completion of the purge.
3) Non-Production Artifacts: Redwood will initiate a staged eviction for non-production artifacts with a maximum window of ninety (90) calendar days from Deletion Event unless otherwise agreed in writing.
4) Backups & Cold Storage: By default, Redwood retains cold backups for one hundred eighty (180) calendar days for disaster recovery. Customer may elect an accelerated purge at the time of Deletion Event; accelerated purges are subject to a processing fee and a 48-hour execution window.
5) Expedited Certification Option: Customer may purchase an Expedited Certification add-on to shorten Certification to fourteen (14) calendar days. Pricing and availability will be listed in the applicable Order Form Addendum.
6) Exceptions: Operational or legal holds (e.g., litigation, subpoena) will pause deletion timelines; Redwood will notify customer and work in good faith to minimize delays.

Notes: I avoided committing to 14 days as standard given third-party backup immutability policies. Also added the accelerated purge as a paid option to keep base SLA reasonable. If this direction works, I can integrate into the redline PDF and prepare a short justification for Procurement.
